interpretations: For each observatory station, average its telescopes’ non-null `bandusagepct` values; retain stations whose average exceeds the average of all individual telescopes’ non-null `bandusagepct` values; return the station, its unrounded average, and the unrounded difference between the two averages, ordered by difference descending, limited to 10 stations
queries:
SELECT
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS average_bandusagepct,
    AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) AS difference
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation
HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes)
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
